component.name: Nexis
component.summary: Linux system optimizer and monitoring tool

description.p: Nexis is a comprehensive system optimizer and monitoring tool for Linux. It provides real-time visibility into your system's health alongside practical tools for cleaning, tuning, and maintaining your machine — all from a unified graphical interface.

ul.li: Live dashboard with CPU, memory, swap, disk, GPU, and network tiles
Hardware info page with detailed CPU, GPU, memory, disk, and battery data
System Cleaner — scan and remove cache, logs, package leftovers, and old downloads
Process manager with GPU %, VRAM, pinned rows, and per-process CPU/memory alerts
Resource charts: CPU, memory, swap, disk I/O, network, GPU, temperature, fan speed, and CPU pressure stall (PSI)
Services manager to start, stop, enable, and disable systemd units
Startup Apps manager for systemd user services and XDG autostart entries
Disk Tools: S.M.A.R.T. health, partition viewer, and benchmark
Uninstaller with post-removal app-crumbs scanner
APT Repository Manager for viewing, adding, and removing sources
Docker container and image manager
Helpers: swappiness, CPU turbo/frequency, SSD TRIM, Wake-on-LAN, and more
System Logs viewer with live filtering
HTML system report export
Scheduled cleaning with optional restore-point creation
Multiple colour themes with per-widget colour customisation

screenshot.caption: Processes page with GPU and VRAM columns

ul.li: Multi-battery support: dual-battery systems (e.g. Dell Rugged 14) now show both batteries in Hardware Info with individual stats; Dashboard shows aggregated charge.
Orphaned Packages view now shows Install Type (Auto/Manual) and Reverse Deps count with color-coded safety indicators on APT systems.
Baobab, Filelight, and QDirStat are now correctly detected and launched when installed via Flatpak, including when running as an AppImage.
System Logs severity filter now correctly fetches matching entries from journalctl instead of filtering a truncated cache.
Update checker no longer fails on non-English system locales.
New "Start minimized in system tray" option in Settings → General.
Flatpak packaging added for Flathub submission.
Toggle indicators no longer disappear on Linux Mint 22 and Ubuntu 24.04 derivatives.
Wi-Fi interfaces now correctly appear in Network Usage.
Window size and position are now remembered across launches.
Select All / Clear All buttons restored in System Cleaner.
Process page search now correctly filters by substring; clearing the field restores the full list.
Application title and Settings page now always display the correct installed version.
APT Repository Manager no longer incorrectly flags Release-only repositories as unreachable.
Restore individual dashboard tiles: an "Add Tile" button appears in Edit Mode when any tile is hidden.
